_comment: The [Ice Floor] area-terrain proof, live through real input -- same fixture->Relc->spar->training_yard route as status_first_encounter (near_ice_floor instead of near_mage_cast: classes {ice_mage:10}, VERIFIED via the inherits-chain to auto-grant frost_bolt/quick_cast/light/ice_shard/icy_floor + flame_jet/mana_shield with zero hand-stuffed player_skills -- see the fixture's own _comment). training_yard has ZERO blocked cells (data/arenas.json), so every cell math below is pure geometry, no LoS complication. Kit order (granted_skills: ice_mage's own L10 grants first, then its inherited mage grants) -> combat kit ice_shard, icy_floor, frost_bolt, flame_jet -> hotbar slots 3/4/5/6 (Attack=1, Dash=2 fixed); icy_floor is slot 4 (hotbar_4). Route: pc spawns (2,3), training_dummy_a/b spawn (7,3)/(7,4) (relc_spar's enemies order). Turn 1 (round 1): Dash first (pool 3->6, AP 4->3) so there's enough pool to BOTH close into icy_floor's range 3 AND step onto the freshly-glazed ice in the SAME turn (the brief's 'move onto ice, end turn, pin the next turn_started' sequence needs the cast and the step-on in one turn so the penalty is live at the very next pc turn, still within the cast round + duration_rounds=2 window). Move right x2 to (4,3) (pool 6->4, chebyshev to (7,3) == 3, exactly icy_floor's range boundary) -> cast icy_floor on the default target (lowest-hp-then-id enemy at full parity HP -- training_dummy_a, alphabetically first, same default-target precedent as status_first_encounter) -> radius-1 blast around (7,3) is the 3x3 block x[6,8] y[2,4], no blocked/oob clipping (training_yard has neither in range) -- the exact 9-cell sorted list asserted below. Then move right x2 more (pool 4->2) onto (6,3), the blast's west edge -- icy, applies slowed to the pc immediately. End turn 1. Dummies auto-end theirs (inert, never act) -- pc's turn 2 (round 2, since one full lap through the 3-member turn_order always advances exactly one round) starts already standing on (6,3): icy_floor's expires_after_round (cast round 1 + duration_rounds 2 - 1 = round 2) hasn't passed yet, so _apply_terrain_status fires at turn-start and is immediately consumed by the existing slowed machinery -- pool floors to maxi(1, 3-2)=1, pinned on THIS turn_started. End turn 2 without moving (pc stays on (6,3)) -- the round 2->3 rollover purges the terrain (expires_after_round 2 < round_number 3), firing ONE terrain_expired for the same 9-cell list, and pc's turn 3 starts off the now-plain cell with a full, unslowed pool (3). Turn 3 ALSO carries issue #60 item 2's flame_jet direction-memory proof (two real player-driven casts, see the step comments right before the finish) since no other canonical ever drives that picker through real input. Finish with combat_autoplay (inert 21-HP-class dummies, basic melee attacks only -- the icy_floor proof is already banked, same low-risk finish status_first_encounter uses) and exit clean.

steps._comment: Move down to the 'Continue' row, confirm loads the near_ice_floor manual slot.
Relc is right below, already met -- 'meet' node's visible options are ['What's out here worth guarding?', 'Got time to show me how to fight? (Spar)', 'Keep walking.'] (index 1 is the spar option).
steps.name: interact

steps._comment: SOCIAL PILLAR II PHASE C: first talk to Relc this waking now absorbs the rotating pool line (dialogue_line + chatted_with_<id> + heard_gossip banks); a second interact opens the real conversation.

payload_contains.speaker: Relc
payload_contains.text: Ha! Good instinct. Everybody swings wrong at the start. Might as well get it done here. Watch keeps training dummies in the gatehouse. I drag a couple out when gate duty gets slow. Don't ask about the wheels. Rules are you move and you hit. That's it. That's all the rules.

steps._comment: 'spar_offer' node: default cursor (0) is 'Ready when you are.' -- accept.
steps.name: confirm

steps._comment: Kit order ice_shard/icy_floor/frost_bolt/flame_jet/flame_dart, then invisibility (all contexts:combat + ap_cost>0 -- issue #46 gave [Invisibility] a real combat read, inherited from mage L5; class-foundation R2 (#93) added [Flame Dart] to mage L2's grants, right after flame_jet, ahead of invisibility) -- Attack(1)/Dash(2)/ice_shard(3)/icy_floor(4)/frost_bolt(5)/flame_jet(6)/flame_dart(7)/invisibility(8)/End Turn = 8 numbered slots, 9 total.
Dash first: pool 3 -> 6, AP 4 -> 3. Needed so this SAME turn can both close into icy_floor's range 3 and step onto the freshly-cast ice afterward.
steps.name: hotbar_2

steps._comment: (2,3) -> (4,3): chebyshev to training_dummy_a (7,3) == 3, exactly icy_floor's range.
Default target is the lowest-hp-then-id enemy -- both dummies start at equal hp, so training_dummy_a (alphabetically first) is targeted with no cycle needed.
steps.name: confirm

steps._comment: Emit order: skill_resolved -> terrain_added -> ui_terrain_rendered (the renderer's confirmation, fired synchronously off terrain_added) -> status_applied per occupant (training_dummy_a, then training_dummy_b -- it also sits inside the blast at (7,4), a deliberate side effect of 'occupied cells included').
Move onto the ice, same turn: (4,3) -> (6,3), the blast's west edge. Applies slowed to the pc immediately (mid-turn, before any pool-penalty consume).
End turn 1 standing on the ice -- the two inert dummies auto-end theirs, then pc's own turn 2 (round 2) begins already on (6,3): the standing-slow proof, live.
steps.name: end_turn

steps._comment: End turn 2 without moving (still on (6,3)) -- the round 2->3 rollover purges icy_floor (expires_after_round 2 < round 3), firing terrain_expired once, then pc's turn 3 starts off the now-plain cell with a full, unslowed pool.
steps.name: end_turn

steps._comment: Issue #60 item 2: [Flame Jet]'s line-direction picker now remembers the LAST direction actually CAST this combat (targeting_controller.gd), instead of always resetting to 'up'. No canonical exercises flame_jet's direction picker via real player input anywhere else (grepped: every other flame_jet reference is a hotbar-presence check or an autoplay finish, never a player-driven cast -- combat_autoplay can't reach it either, melee-profile default per CLAUDE.md Gotchas), so this is the ONLY pin -- added here rather than a new script since turn 3 is already a stable, fully-resourced state (fresh 4 AP, 13 of 17 mp banked after the single earlier icy_floor cast) with nothing left to prove about icy_floor itself. Still at (6,3): flame_jet ap_cost 2 fits BOTH casts in this one turn (2+2=4 AP), mp_cost 4 each (8 of 13 -- no depletion). 'down' (one cycle off the pristine 'up' default, LINE_DIRS order up/down/left/right) walks (6,4)-(6,7) -- neither dummy (7,3)/(7,4) sits in that column, so this is a clean zero-damage geometry probe, not a combat-outcome risk.
steps.name: hotbar_6

steps._comment: Second cast, SAME turn, position unchanged, NO cycle at all before confirm -- if the picker still reset to 'up' on every fresh entry (the pre-#60 behavior) this would resolve target:'up'; it resolves 'down' again instead, proving the per-combat memory. A fresh WICombatTargeting is constructed per encounter (combat_screen.gd._show_combat()), so this memory needs no explicit reset anywhere -- a LATER combat starts a brand new instance back at 'up'.
steps.name: hotbar_6

steps._comment: Issue #75 item 1: the aim preview's LINE path -- WICombatTargeting.aim_preview() -> _view.line_cells(), the exact cells the confirmed cast walks (asserted below via skill_resolved). Entry already defaults to 'down' (the remembered direction, no cycle needed this time), so the preview shows the SAME 4-cell path the cast is about to resolve -- the direction-memory fix and the aim preview agreeing is the point.
The icy_floor proof is banked; finish the fight with plain autoplay (melee-profile default -- 21-HP-class inert dummies, real kit, no risk).
